name: Necrotrap
summary: Necrotrap is an internet-based music genre and aggressive derivative of Trap Metal that originated from the SoundCloud rap underground in the early 2020s.
description:
Necrotrap is an internet-based music genre and aggressive derivative of Trap Metal that originated from the SoundCloud rap underground in the early 2020s. The genre is built around heavily distorted 808 basslines with aggressive vocal delivery influenced by metal, incorporating Drum and Bass and Dubstep elements primarily in kick patterns and mixing approach.

The genre's production centers on 808 basslines pushed through heavy saturation and distortion to achieve maximum loudness while maintaining controlled mixing standards. Visually, the movement pairs degraded low-fidelity imagery with cyberwarfare motifs to build a combat-focused visual world. Even though Necrotrap was initially a brand for the collective NECROSOCIETY, the genre has since evolved into a decentralized online music movement centered on themes of modern warfare, horror/gore, and hacker culture. Unlike broader Trap Metal, where artists frequently use their music as an outlet for emotional volatility, Necrotrap's aggression is oriented toward shock value and world-building roleplay rather than emotional catharsis.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Aggression, animalistic intensity, controlled distortion, world-building, shock value
